content.content: WHEN the user presses `/` with no modifier, the viewer shall open a focused search field over the graph the webview panel's interactive HTML page presents, leaving the current selection, pan and zoom unchanged.
content.rationale: The decision fixes the invocation and opening of the find-by-text interaction ksoupzqm records; it states only when the query surface opens and what opening it does not disturb, and leaves matching, how matches are reported, movement between them, closing, reload behaviour and mounting to the decisions that descend from this one. The field is placed over the graph the panel's interactive HTML page presents, the single presentation surface the prerequisite records, and the trigger and the query it will carry use only the page's own input and the supply of a text query that the prerequisite records, so no other surface or medium is presumed. The preservation clause is what makes opening non-disruptive rather than a mode change: the current selection and the current pan and zoom of the presented graph stay as they were, so search is added as one more interaction on the presented graph without replacing or resetting what the viewer is already showing.
